lessons.title: The Boss Arena: Containerize It!
lessons.content_md:
# The Boss Arena: Containerize It! ⚔️ You've learned about Data Centers, IaaS vs PaaS, Object Storage, and the power of Docker Containers. Now, it's time to prove you are ready to be a Cloud Engineer. In this final Capstone Project, you will write a real web application, package it perfectly into a Docker Container (the shipping container of the internet!), and push your code to GitHub. *(Note: In the future, our AI Evaluator will pull your GitHub repository and grade your code live!)* ## Step 1: The App 📄 Create a new folder on your computer called `cloud-capstone`. Inside that folder, create a file named `index.html`. Write the following code into the file: ```html My First Cloud App

Hello from the Cloud! ☁️

I have successfully containerized my first application.

``` ## Step 2: The Dockerfile 🐳 Now, we need to create the instructions to build our Docker container. We need a tiny, lightweight web server to serve our HTML file. In the exact same folder, create a file named `Dockerfile` (no extension). Write the following code: ```dockerfile # Use a lightweight Nginx web server image as our base FROM nginx:alpine # Copy our index.html file into the container's web directory COPY index.html /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html # Expose port 80 so the internet can see it EXPOSE 80 ``` ## Step 3: Build & Test (Optional) 🛠️ If you have Docker installed on your computer, you can build and test your container right now! Open your terminal and run: ```bash docker build -t my-cloud-app . docker run -p 8080:80 my-cloud-app ``` If you go to `http://localhost:8080` in your browser, you should see your app running perfectly inside its container! ## Step 4: Push to GitHub 🐙 To complete this level, you must push your code to a public GitHub repository. 1. Initialize a git repository: `git init` 2. Add your files: `git add index.html Dockerfile` 3. Commit: `git commit -m "My first containerized app"` 4. Push to a new public repo on your GitHub account. When you are done, click the **Complete** button below to claim your massive XP reward and finish the Cloud Computing track!
